cover.headline: Three bundles, side by side, for Sam & Pat
cover.subtext: We quoted your home, your Honda and your Toyota with three carriers. Here's how each bundle compares, and the one we recommend.

strip.text: Raise auto property damage to $100,000 with Liberty Mutual · to match the Travelers and National General quotes

insured_lines: 2018 Honda CR-V LX · 2016 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab

pages.headline: Sam & Pat, thank you.
pages.pull_quote: The lowest price and the most home protection, from the same carrier.
paragraphs: Thank you for letting us shop your insurance. We quoted your home at 100 Example Lane, Charlotte, NC 28277, and both vehicles as a bundle with three carriers: Liberty Mutual, Travelers and National General.

Liberty Mutual comes out on top. It's $231.18 a year less than Travelers and $791.18 less than National General. It also gives you the highest personal property limit ($350,000), $300,000 of personal liability, water back-up and service line coverage, and accident forgiveness on the auto policy. Pay the auto policy in full and you save another $92.00.

One change we recommend: Liberty Mutual's quote carries $50,000 of auto property damage liability, while Travelers and National General carry $100,000. We'll raise it to $100,000 and confirm the small price difference with you before anything is signed. Call or email me when you're ready, and we can bind the same day.

why.title: Why Liberty Mutual
why.text: Lowest bundle price, the most belongings coverage, $300,000 of liability, accident forgiveness and a pay-in-full auto discount.

why.title: Why Travelers
why.text: A solid option with $100,000 property damage, buried utility lines and roadside assistance. It costs $231.18 more a year than Liberty Mutual.

why.title: Why National General
why.text: The highest bundle price, only $100,000 of home liability, a $2,000 wind/hail deductible, and wind/hail roof claims paid at depreciated value.

pages.headline: Your home, insured three ways.
pages.lede: All three carriers insure the house for the same $500,000 dwelling limit, plus 25% more if rebuilding costs run over. The differences are in belongings coverage, liability, extras and price.

pages.headline: What these policies won't cover.
pages.lede: Every home and auto policy has exclusions and limits. Here is what applies to all three bundles, and where each carrier differs.

common.title: Flood
common.text: Homeowners policies never cover flood. Flood insurance is a separate policy we can quote.

common.title: Earthquake
common.text: Not included in any of the three home quotes.

common.title: Water back-up
common.text: Sewer or sump back-up is capped at $15,000 on all three.

common.title: Rideshare & delivery driving
common.text: Personal auto policies limit coverage while driving for an app. Tell us before you start.

items.title: Auto property damage
items.text: Quoted at $50,000, lower than the others. We are re-quoting at $100,000.

items.title: Roof wind & hail
items.text: Roof surfacing damaged by wind or hail is paid at actual cash value (depreciated), not replacement cost.

pages.fine: This is a summary of what each quote lists, not the full policy. The policy contract controls.

callout.title: Closing the gaps
callout.text: Flood insurance, earthquake coverage and a higher water back-up limit can usually be added. Ask us for a price on any of them before you bind.

sections.title: Your home
rows: Pays to rebuild the house itself: walls, roof, floors, built-ins. The limit is based on rebuilding cost, not what the home would sell for.
If a rebuild costs more than $500,000, all three quotes add up to 25% more. Construction costs spike after big storms, so this matters.
Covers structures not attached to the house, such as fences, the driveway or a shed.
Covers your belongings. With replacement cost, you're paid what it costs to buy the item new, with no deduction for age.
If a covered loss forces you out of the house, this pays for a hotel, meals above your normal budget and other extra living costs.
Liability pays your legal defense and any judgment if someone is hurt on your property. Med pay covers a guest's small medical bills quickly, whoever was at fault.
Standard policies exclude water from a backed-up drain or failed sump pump. This fills that gap, and it's one of the most common claims we see.
Covers repairs to the underground water, sewer, power and gas lines running to your house, including digging up the yard.

sections.title: Your autos
rows: If you cause an accident that injures someone, this pays their medical bills and lost wages and covers your legal defense.
Pays for damage you cause to someone else's car or property. Many new trucks and SUVs cost more than $50,000, which is why we recommend $100,000.
If a driver with no insurance, or too little, hits you, this covers your injuries and your car's damage.
Comprehensive covers theft, hail, vandalism and deer strikes. Collision repairs your car after a crash, whoever caused it. You pay the deductible first.
Rental pays for a car while yours is in the shop after a covered loss. Towing or roadside covers breakdowns, flats and jump-starts.
With Liberty Mutual, after three years with the carrier your first at-fault accident won't raise your premium, under the carrier's rules.

stats.sub: All three quotes insure the dwelling at $500,000, above this estimate.

roof.note: National General would pay wind/hail roof surfacing claims at actual cash value. On a 10-year-old roof, that means a depreciated payout. Safeco and Travelers don't list that limitation.

pages.headline: Choosing a plan and getting started.
pages.fine: Monthly amounts come from each carrier's quote and include any installment fees they list. Liberty Mutual's EFT auto plan adds a $2.00 fee per installment; its home plan has no fee. Liberty Mutual figures will change slightly once property damage is raised to $100,000.

info.title: About the property damage limit
info.text: Liberty Mutual's quote carries $50,000 of property damage liability. We'll re-quote it at $100,000, the same as the other two carriers, and confirm the new premium with you before you sign.

info.title: Worth a conversation: an umbrella
info.text: With a home and two vehicles, a personal umbrella adds a layer of liability protection, often $1 million, above your home and auto limits. Ask us to quote it alongside this bundle.
